statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I48.91, R55
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the suspected arrhythmias underlying the recurrent syncope and palpitations
